title: ARS Response Record
description: JSONL record schema for one AI-generated response in the AI Recommendation Share (ARS) study. One object per line in data/responses.jsonl. See PROTOCOL.md (D10, section 10.5) for full field definitions and recording rules.

response_id.description: Unique identifier for the response; must match response_id in every annotation record for this response.

question_id.description: The Market Question Cell identifier; matches question_id in annotation records.

platform.description: The AI platform that produced the response.

model_version.description: The platform's disclosed model identifier where available (e.g., gpt-4o-2024-08-06). null if not disclosed; validator emits W3 warning.

timestamp_collected.description: ISO 8601 (UTC) timestamp of when the response was collected.

full_text.description: The complete verbatim response text. evidence_span values in annotation records must be substrings of this field (R-F.8, enforced by validate.py E4).

citations.description: URLs and titles cited in the response. Empty array if none.

sponsored_block_present.description: true if the response contains any disclosed sponsored/promotional block. Per-event sponsored flags (R-F.15) identify which brand appearances fall inside such a block.

self_disclosure.description: Platform self-disclosure metadata (R-F.14). When the platform discloses its identity but names no classified brand, the disclosure is recorded here, not as a per-event flag.

allOf.description: When present is false, verbatim and vendor must be null.
When present is true, verbatim must be a non-empty string; vendor should be a string.

collection_channel.description: How the response was collected: web UI or API.

collection_version.description: Semantic version of the collection instrument (distinct from protocol_version, which is the coding protocol).
